Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that uses the pyaedt library to create a 2D Extractor CPWG (coplanar waveguide with ground) design and run a simulation. The code should import the necessary libraries, set the non-graphical mode, launch AEDT and 2D Extractor, define variables, create primitives, create a signal, create a coplanar ground, create a reference ground plane, create a dielectric, create a conformal coating, assign a conductor to the signal, create a reference ground, assign the Huray model on the signal, create the setup, analyze it, plot solution data, save the project and close AEDT.

You can find the following APIs from the library helpful:
point_a, icepak_a, hfss3dl_a, test_54b_open_and_load_a_polyline, test_09b_export_report_A, create_sheet_to_ground, _create_conformal, create_waveguide, create_plane, CreateAedtApplication, CreateAedtObj, create, _create_setup, create_setup, source_terms_to_ground, CreateAedtBlockObj, signal, create_new_project, create_dataset1d_project, create_3d_plot

message.content:
```python
from pyaedt import Hfss2dExtractor, Desktop
import os

# Set non-graphical mode
non_graphical = True

# Launch AEDT and 2D Extractor
desktop = Desktop(specified_version="2024.1", non_graphical=non_graphical, new_desktop_session=True)
project_name = "CPWG_2D_Extractor"
design_name = "CPWG_Design"
aedtapp = Hfss2dExtractor(projectname=project_name, designname=design_name, specified_version="2024.1", new_desktop_session=False)

# Define variables
aedtapp["cpw_w"] = "2mm"
aedtapp["cpw_s"] = "0.5mm"
aedtapp["cpw_g"] = "3mm"
aedtapp["cpw_l"] = "20mm"
aedtapp["cpw_t"] = "0.035mm"
aedtapp["dielectric_thickness"] = "0.8mm"
aedtapp["dielectric_er"] = "4.4"
aedtapp["conformal_thickness"] = "0.01mm"
aedtapp["conformal_er"] = "3.0"

# Create primitives
# Signal trace
signal = aedtapp.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=[0, 0],
    dimension_list=["cpw_l", "cpw_w"],
    name="Signal",
    matname="copper"
)

# Coplanar ground (two rectangles on each side of the signal)
ground1 = aedtapp.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=[0, "-(cpw_s+cpw_w)"],
    dimension_list=["cpw_l", "cpw_g"],
    name="CoplanarGround1",
    matname="copper"
)
ground2 = aedtapp.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=[0, "cpw_w+cpw_s"],
    dimension_list=["cpw_l", "cpw_g"],
    name="CoplanarGround2",
    matname="copper"
)

# Reference ground plane (below signal and coplanar ground)
ref_ground = aedtapp.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=[0, "-(cpw_g+cpw_s+cpw_w)"],
    dimension_list=["cpw_l", "2*cpw_g+2*cpw_s+cpw_w"],
    name="RefGround",
    matname="copper"
)
aedtapp.modeler.move(ref_ground, [0, 0, "-dielectric_thickness"])

# Dielectric
dielectric = aedtapp.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=[0, "-(cpw_g+cpw_s+cpw_w)"],
    dimension_list=["cpw_l", "2*cpw_g+2*cpw_s+cpw_w"],
    name="Dielectric",
    matname="FR4_epoxy"
)
aedtapp.modeler.move(dielectric, [0, 0, 0])

# Conformal coating
conformal = aedtapp.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=[0, "-(cpw_g+cpw_s+cpw_w)"],
    dimension_list=["cpw_l", "2*cpw_g+2*cpw_s+cpw_w"],
    name="Conformal",
    matname="conformal"
)
aedtapp.modeler.move(conformal, [0, 0, "dielectric_thickness"])
aedtapp.modeler.thicken_sheet(conformal, "conformal_thickness", False)

# Assign conductor to signal
aedtapp.assign_single_conductor(signal, "Signal")

# Assign ground to coplanar grounds and reference ground
aedtapp.assign_single_conductor(ground1, "CoplanarGround1", is_reference_ground=False)
aedtapp.assign_single_conductor(ground2, "CoplanarGround2", is_reference_ground=False)
aedtapp.assign_single_conductor(ref_ground, "RefGround", is_reference_ground=True)

# Assign Huray model to signal
aedtapp.assign_huray_surface(signal, roughness_value=0.5, model_type="Huray", surface_name="Signal")

# Create setup
setup = aedtapp.create_setup(name="Setup1")
setup.props["Frequency"] = "10GHz"
setup.update()

# Analyze
aedtapp.analyze_setup("Setup1")

# Plot solution data
solution_data = aedtapp.get_solution_data(expressions=["Z0"], setup_sweep_name="Setup1 : LastAdaptive")
solution_data.plot()

# Save project and close AEDT
aedtapp.save_project()
aedtapp.release_desktop(close_projects=True, close_desktop=True)
```
